objective: Create a restartable, disk-bounded, exact BF16 full-sequence block-input and block-output cache for every Qwen3.8-27B text layer. Preserve all 12 prompts by 64 token positions so mixed CQ3/AFF3 attention training has the complete recurrent and causal context that the rejected selected-row v41 design omitted.

scope.layer_pattern: three linear_attention blocks followed by one full_attention block, repeated sixteen times

design_correction.fault: v41 retained isolated selected rows even though full-attention softmax and recurrent linear-attention state make the trained block response depend on the complete 64-token sequence
design_correction.correction: persist every BF16 token state at both endpoints of every layer; row ordinals remain metadata only and never substitute for sequence context

semantic_placement_addendum.placement: complete block output correction from complete block input

data_protocol.source: reuse the exact token IDs, attention mask, positions, row ordinals, and text lists from the authenticated pilot cache
data_protocol.benchmark_contamination_forbidden: No CUTE, MATH-500, code, MMLU, WikiText, fresh-confirmation text, or generated model output enters this cache.

execution.streaming: load one exact safetensors layer into a meta-instantiated Qwen3.5 decoder block, propagate the complete hidden state, atomically persist that layer input/output shard, then release the layer
execution.checkpoint_unit: each layer PT shard plus authenticated JSON descriptor is independently terminal and the contiguous descriptor prefix defines the resume point
execution.resume: accept only a gap-free prefix whose model, revision, preregistration hash, parent-cache hash, producer commit, layer index, layer type, sizes, and file hashes all match; resume from the exact prior output
execution.context_identity: an existing context artifact must equal the context reconstructed from the authenticated parent cache tensor-for-tensor and metadata-for-metadata
execution.pilot_parity: complete inputs and outputs at layers 0, 32, and 63 must equal the authenticated pilot tensors bit-for-bit
execution.allocator_control: run garbage collection and libc malloc_trim after every streamed layer
execution.completion_order: after all 64 terminal shards exist, atomically save a receipt containing the exact shard ledger, then atomically save the completion marker

promotion_rules: run the frozen full-context stream and accept only a complete gap-free ledger of 64 layer shards
any source, context, layer-pattern, shape, dtype, finite-value, pilot-parity, shard-size, prefix, or terminal identity failure is terminal or infrastructure-invalid as classified by the runner
pilot layers 0, 32, and 63 must reproduce the old complete inputs and outputs bit-for-bit
a pass admits one restartable 64-layer expansion of the already-frozen mixed CQ3 MLP and AFF3 attention training algebra and hyperparameters
the cache is not a quantized model, quality result, runtime result, or scientific breakthrough
fresh confirmation remains sealed until a complete all-layer candidate and its sensitivity-selected residual payloads are frozen
next_if_passed: Preregister one restartable 64-layer expansion of the frozen mixed CQ3 MLP and AFF3 attention-output fit using full sequence responses, apply the unchanged validation-error sensitivity rule, and train the already-frozen rank-16 complete-block residual only on admitted layers before opening untouched confirmation and whole-model gates.
claim_boundary: A pass proves only that exact frozen full-sequence BF16 block inputs and outputs for all 64 Qwen3.8-27B text layers were streamed and cached with authenticated pilot parity under bounded CPU resources. It does not establish approximation quality, a complete model, end-to-end capability or speed, novelty, or a scientific breakthrough.
